tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rta mgrin snying po don sbyor gyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so// 1$0000300oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mnyam nyid spros bral dag pa'i pho brang du// chos sku kun bzang yab yum la gsol ba 'debs// lhun grub 'od lnga 'khrigs pa'i pho brang du// longs sku zhi khro yab yum la gsol ba 'debs// rnam dag stug po bkod pa'i pho brang du// sprul sku rdor 'chang yab yum la gsol ba 'debs// 'od gsal me dpung 'bar ba'i pho brang du/ ston pa rdor sems yab yum la gsol ba 'debs// dur khrod gsang chen rol pa'i pho brang du// rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs// dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang du// o rgyan gu ru yab yum la gsol ba 'debs// bka' babs lung bstan dam tshig pho brang du// rigs ldan chos blo mgon po la gsol ba 'debs// snang srid sgyu mar grol ba'i pho brang du// rig 'dzin mchog ldan rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs// bde stong chos nyid rol pa'i pho brang du// chos bdag gsang ba'i ḍā ki la gsol ba 'debs// dbang chen zla gam 'khyil pa'i pho brang du// gter chen bsam gtan gling pa la gsol ba 'debs// 'gro don phyogs med mdzad pa'i pho brang du// drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// brag dkar lha chu gsang ba'i gter gnas su// dam chos snying po don sbyor la gsol ba 'debs// rang lus gdan gsum lha yi gzhal yas su// yi dam rta phag yab yum la gsol ba 'debs// bde stong rtsa rlung thig le'i grong khyer du// rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la gsol ba 'debs// bka' dang dam tshig gnyan po'i pho brang du// bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs// mkhyen brtse ye shes rgyas pa'i skyabs mchog rnams// gsol 'debs bu la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// bdag rgyud smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs// gzhan don 'bad med 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// sgrub la bar chad med par byin gyis rlobs// bskyed rdzogs mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs// tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs//
ces pa'ang gu ṇas khyer bder bkod pa dge legs 'phel// //
